qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the plug for pressure relief valve on M10/M30 engines?
What torque should be applied to the M20 plug for pressure relief valve?
What screw size and torque specification is used for oil pump to crankcase?
What is the torque specification for the oil pump cover?
How much torque should be applied to the sprocket to oil pump connection?
What are the two different torque specifications shown for M10 screws in this oil pump section?
qa_pairs.answer: 47 Nm for M10 screws and 25 Nm for M10x1 screws

qa_pairs.question: Which components in the oil pump assembly use M6 screws?
qa_pairs.answer: Oil pump cover and sprocket to oil pump both use M6 screws

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque specification between M10/M30 and M20 pressure relief valve plugs?
qa_pairs.answer: M10/M30 requires 40 Nm while M20 requires 30 Nm, a difference of 10 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection covers these oil pump torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 11-26 Engine, subsection 11 41 Oil Pump with Strainer and Drive

qa_pairs.question: Which oil pump components apply to all engine types?
qa_pairs.answer: Oil pump to crankcase, oil pump cover, and sprocket to oil pump all apply to all engine types
